items.statement: The workflow treats clean slab, isolated Li, one-Li endpoint and full first-layer endpoint as distinct named systems and applies one adsorption-energy convention.
items.expected: All four systems, atom counts, and formula are explicit.

items.statement: The Cu(111) geometry and relaxation boundary are validated before interpreting energies.
items.expected: The report checks five layers, p(5x5), vacuum, fcc registry, and layer masks, with convergence or sensitivity evidence.

items.statement: Average first-layer Li adsorption is weaker at full coverage than for an isolated Li atom.
items.expected: The endpoint comparison reports a less-negative theta=1 value and both endpoint energies.

items.statement: The clean-slab surface energy is a validation observable for the slab model.
items.expected: A surface-energy diagnostic and limitations are reported.
